name: drupal/aim
description: Drupal-native AI agent memory infrastructure: governed, Guardrail-checked, extracted-and-consolidated, vector-searchable memory for AI agents.

suggest.drupal/eca: Enables aim_eca's FactWrite/FactQuery/FactState plugins for ECA-driven memory writes and queries; deprioritized in favor of the separate eca_tool project, see CLAUDE.md.
suggest.drupal/ai_context: Integration point for CCC to call aim's Tool API tools as curated policy; aim exposes no code path that requires it directly, see ADR-0008.
suggest.drupal/queue_ui: Adds an admin UI button to manually run the aim_consolidate queue worker without a shell, see CLAUDE.md's Consolidation section.
suggest.drupal/simple_oauth: Required by aim_tool_oauth to let a remote MCP client (no Drupal session) authenticate as an OAuth2 client, see CLAUDE.md's MCP OAuth section.
suggest.e0ipso/simple_oauth_21: Required by aim_tool_oauth for RFC 9728 discovery metadata and dynamic client registration (not on drupal.org, this is its real Packagist name).
suggest.drupal/mcp_server_oauth-mcp_server_oauth: Required by aim_tool_oauth to enforce OAuth2 scopes on aim_remember/aim_recall; self-doubled Composer name, same drupal.org packaging bug as mcp_server_tool_bridge.
